how.title: How it works
how.s1b: Tell us where you promote. We answer within a couple of days.
how.s2b: Your own code and a ready-made link. Share it anywhere — a channel, a description, a story.
how.s3b: Commission accrues automatically. Withdraw to a card when it adds up.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.q1: When do I get the money?
faq.a1: Commission accrues once an order is delivered and becomes withdrawable 14 days later. That wait covers refunds and disputes — without it we would have to claw money back after paying it.
faq.a2: 50,000 UZS. Every transfer is made by hand, so there is a floor.
faq.q3: What if a buyer gets a refund?
faq.a3: If it happens before the hold period ends, the commission on that order is reversed. After that, the money stays yours.
faq.q4: Does the code work for existing customers?
faq.a4: No. The code works only on someone's first order — it is for bringing new buyers, not a discount for regulars.
faq.q5: What do I earn on repeat orders?
faq.a5: The same as on the first. The buyer is yours for good, and you earn on every order they place — not only the one where they typed your code.
faq.q6: Do I need a big audience?
faq.a6: There is no minimum. What matters is how close your topic is to what we sell — a small gaming channel fits better than a large one about something else.
